scope: Private checker windowed, counted and single-callback iteration. All fifty Go checker decisions have independent Rust execution witnesses. Other native callbacks, general object and host dispatch and pending-address effects remain explicitly incomplete. These are Go checker decisions, not Go execution results.

cases.source: def run; a=[]; result=[7,9,11].each_slice(2) {|pair| a.push(pair)}; [a,result]; end
def run; a=[]; result=[7,9,11].each_cons(2) {|pair| a.push(pair)}; [a,result]; end
def run; a=[]; [7,9,11].each_slice(2) {|l,r| a.push([l,r])}; a; end
def run; a=[]; [7,9].each_slice(9223372036854775807) {|pair| a.push(pair)}; a; end
def run; a=[]; result=[7,9].cycle(2) {|n| a.push(n)}; [a,result]; end
def run; a=[7,9]; seen=[]; a.cycle(2) {|n| a.clear; seen.push(n)}; [a,seen]; end
def run; a=[]; [7,9].cycle {a.push(3); break 7}; a; end
def run; [7].cycle(nil) {return 7}; missing; end
cases.difference: Rust follows native callback contracts and reachable control transfers.

def run; 7.tap {break 9}; end
def run; [].each_slice(2) {missing}; end
